description: Use when an agent needs a spot price without choosing a venue. Returns the price, the venue that actually served it, and a Pyth confidence when Pyth served. Coinbase, then Kraken, then Pyth Hermes. Serves SOL, BTC and ETH; anything else is declined. Costs 0.001 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana or Base).

symbol.description: SOL, BTC or ETH (default SOL). Anything else is declined with the supported list
